import sys, json, time, base64, csv, io, random, subprocess, resource
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/dev'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps')
from harness import *
import zstandard as zstd

random.seed(7)
NLEASE = 300
leases = [lease('L%03d' % i, '2001:db8:%x::/56' % (0x1000 + i), 0, 1000, (0, 1, 2, 3), 8)
          for i in range(NLEASE)]
S = {'web': 'tcp', 'dev': 'adb', 'mob': 'sync'}
targets = {}
rows = []
out = io.StringIO(newline='')
w = csv.writer(out, lineterminator='\n')
w.writerow(HEADER.split(','))
n = 0
for i, L in enumerate(leases):
    for sub in (0, 1, 2, 3):
        base = 0x20010db8 << 96 | (0x1000 + i) << 48
        for k in range(1, 9):
            tgt = base + k
            rows.append(['icmp', 'p%d' % n, '0', '5', 'put', L['id'], '3',
                         '%d/i%d' % (sub, k), str(ip(tgt) if False else __import__('ipaddress').IPv6Address(tgt)),
                         str(__import__('ipaddress').IPv6Address(tgt)), 'echo', '', '', ''])
            n += 1
print('icmp rows', n, file=sys.stderr)
# pad with app rows up to 200000
from protocols import adb_packet, get_value_request
cn = base64.b64encode(adb_packet(0x4e584e43, 0x01000000, 4096, b'host::zgrab2')).decode()
while n < 199900:
    L = leases[n % NLEASE]
    rows.append(['app', 'q%d' % n, '0', '5', 'put', L['id'], '3', '',
                 str(__import__('ipaddress').IPv6Address(0x20010db8000000000000000000000000 + 1 + (n % 32))),
                 '', 'open', 'dev', '0', cn])
    n += 1
for r in rows:
    w.writerow(r)
text = out.getvalue()
print('csv bytes', len(text), file=sys.stderr)
data = text.encode()
zdata = zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(data)
print('zstd bytes', len(zdata), file=sys.stderr)
chunks = [b64(zdata[i:i + 60000]) for i in range(0, len(zdata), 60000)]
cap = {'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': chunks}
job = campaign(leases, S, [10, 500, 999], [cap])
t = time.time()
got, errtext = run(job)
print('time', round(time.time() - t, 2), file=sys.stderr)
print('err', errtext[:400], file=sys.stderr)
print('keys', list(got.keys()), file=sys.stderr)
print('ledger', [s['ledger'] for s in got['snapshots']], file=sys.stderr)
print('first lease', json.dumps(got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0])[:400], file=sys.stderr)
print('maxrss child MB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss / 1024, file=sys.stderr)
PYEOF
timeout 300 python3 stress1.py
